statement: Wafer buyers are rebuilding safety stock and lengthening contracts from about three years to five-to-eight years, with spot 300mm prices starting to rise
why: Customers stockpiling and locking in years of supply is classic behaviour just before a shortage bites.

impact.mechanism: Safety-stock rebuild adds demand on top of production needs while long-term agreements absorb available volume, leaving less for spot buyers and pushing spot prices up.

evidence.excerpt: customers are rebuilding wafer safety stock and requesting new 300mm volumes
Contract terms are lengthening from about three years to five-to-eight years

confidence.basis: One outlet's summary citing several wafer makers' earnings releases; publishers quoted inside a single document do not count as independent corroboration.

dispersion: Siltronic supplies two-thirds of volume via long-term agreements; Shin-Etsu now supplies all 300mm wafers under such agreements; GlobalWafers' Micron deal runs 10 years.
